head: Paint Anytime: a drawing app for Apple Watch with layers
dek: Paint Anytime lets you draw and paint on your Apple Watch, with brushes, layers, a lasso and a fill tool. It was #28 in Graphics & Design on the US App Store's paid chart on 16 November.
details: It costs $2.99 with no in-app purchases and needs watchOS 10 or later. There are six brush presets, custom colour palettes, draw-and-hold shape correction, undo and redo, a gallery of saved drawings and watch face widgets; you can share drawings by iMessage or email. It's made by Denis Kolchev, and its code is open source.
means: If you like to doodle while you wait, this turns the watch on your wrist into a small sketchpad.
todo: Start with the built-in tutorial: it shows the brushes and gestures on the small screen.
